output.one_liner: Cloud-based customer relationship management platform for managing sales pipelines, customer interactions, and business processes.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 with bearer token; supports authorization code and client credentials flows

evidence.snippet: OAuth2.0 requests are usually authenticated with an access token, which is passed as bearer token.
The client credentials flow can be used to perform one-time tasks like one-time data migration or testing Zoho CRM API calls, etc.

access.notes: Free developer edition with full CRM features; free tier includes 5000 API credits daily

evidence.snippet: Zoho CRM's free developer edition is a fully-featured application environment that helps developers explore Zoho CRM and test their applications.
If your organization requires more API credits than the allowed limit for your edition, the super-admin of your org can increase the credit limit from the API Dashboard.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Credit-based rate limiting: Free tier 5000 credits daily; concurrency limits 5-20 depending on edition; no time-based restrictions

evidence.snippet: Core APIs - Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
GraphQL APIs - Learn how to request specific resources, fields of the resources and relationships of the resources in a single query.
Webhooks in Zoho CRM allow you to send real-time data from Zoho CRM to external applications or services when specific events occur
Deploy four composable MCP servers that give your AI agent secure, scoped access to your Zoho CRM.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free developer tier, well-documented REST/GraphQL APIs, OAuth2 authentication, webhooks, and official MCP servers enable toolkit development today.

overview_evidence.snippet: Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
